Returns the buffer of one frame of an image, which [SetBuffer](SetBuffer) can make the target of all drawing commands. The buffer is also the one that [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and [ReadPixel](ReadPixel) work on.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(32, 32, 2)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img, 0)
Color 255, 0, 0
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img, 1)
Color 0, 0, 255
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
DrawImage img, 60, 100, 0
DrawImage img, 140, 100, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param image  The image.
@param frame  The frame whose buffer to return. Defaults to 0.
@returns A buffer handle for [SetBuffer](SetBuffer) and the pixel commands.
@gap A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
